purpose: Public-domain small-scale land outlines for a decorative landing-page globe; not a coastline navigation, reef-boundary, flow, plastic, or tank dataset.

dataset.name: Natural Earth 1:110 million land
dataset.version_note: The catalogue version is not asserted to identify this independently commit-pinned GeoJSON byte payload.

license.name: Public domain
license.summary: Natural Earth states that its raster and vector map data are public domain and may be used and modified for personal, educational, or commercial purposes without permission.

asset.antimeridian_note: Use longitude/latitude on a sphere, respect each polygon/ring and holes, and handle the 180/-180 seam. The only ring segment with an absolute longitude difference above 180 degrees is Antarctica closure [180,-90] to [-180,-90], the same South Pole on a sphere; never render it as a straight line across a planar world map.

fallback.projection: Orthographic; inverse per-pixel visible-hemisphere sampling against the unchanged Natural Earth land polygons
fallback.lighting: Deterministic Lambert-style top-left diffuse illumination; navy water and off-white land; no generative imagery
fallback.limits: A 1:110-million-scale visual backdrop, not validated site geometry or scientific experiment evidence.
